name: visaslot.competence
description: Find the competent consulate for a trip. Give every stay in the Schengen area with its country and dates; nights are counted per country. The main destination is the country with the most nights; on a tie, the tied country entered first (earliest check-in). Returns the night counts, the main country, which rule decided it and the consulates of that country. Reading changes nothing.

name: visaslot.slots
description: List the open appointment slots at a consulate between two local dates (inclusive), earliest first. Slots in the past and slots taken, booked or closed are not listed; availability changes over time. Each slot carries its version: book with it. Reading changes nothing.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; slot times carry its UTC offset and dates are local dates there.

name: visaslot.book
description: Book an open slot. Give the slot time and the slot version from visaslot.slots. A slot taken since the search fails with slot_unavailable; a slot whose version changed fails with stale_version. Booking is free.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE or FR.

version.description: Increases on booking, reschedule, cancellation and hold. A file submission does not change it.

slot_at.description: The slot the appointment held after this step.

history.description: Every booking, reschedule, cancellation and hold, with the slot held after it.

items.description: One entry per failed rule, in rule order.

file_version.description: Version of the registered visa file, or null when none is registered.

name: visaslot.reschedule
description: Move a booked appointment to another open slot at the same consulate before the current slot starts. Give the appointment version and the new slot version you read; stale versions fail with stale_version. The old slot is released. A registered visa file stays on the appointment.

name: visaslot.cancel

name: visaslot.checklist
description: Read the required-document checklist for a visa category, e.g. business. Each item says which VisaSlot rules check it at the appointment. Reading changes nothing.

checked_by.description: Rules VisaSlot applies to this item at the appointment; empty when the consulate checks it in person.

name: visaslot.file.submit
description: Register the visa file on a booked appointment, replacing any earlier file, until the appointment starts. Give the invitation letter, travel signature, every accommodation stay and the travel dates, each with the source record you read it from. A letter or signature dated after today at the consulate is rejected. Returns the file and the items that would be missing if the appointment were held now.

source.description: The record the agent read these facts from. VisaSlot stores it for grading; it never reads that App.

issued_on.description: Date the letter was issued. Must not be after the submission date at the consulate.
